                                       Resolution 2026-07
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                 RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
   FOR THE PURCHASE OF FIRE DEPARTMENT COMMAND VEHICLE

   WHEREAS, in 2022, Girdwood Fire and Rescue Inc (GFR) identified the need to purchase 3 replacement command
    vehicles, and this was discussed and approved both the Girdwood Fire Board and Girdwood Board of Supervisors;
   and

   WHEREAS, the original proposal was that two command vehicles would be purchased from the Girdwood Fire 406
    account and one vehicle purchased via from Municipal Areawide funding sources due to its function of moving
   emergency medical supplies; and

   WHEREAS, in 2023, the Municipal Areawide funded two command vehicles via SEMT funding and it was
    determined the third vehicle would be purchased under Girdwood 406 capital account; and,

   WHEREAS; the Girdwood Fire and Rescue Board on April 29, 2026 reaffirmed their request for the third command
    vehicle to be purchased via the Girdwood Fire Department 406 capital account.

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Fire and Rescue 406 capital account has adequate funds available.

   THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors supports the purchase of one vehicle replacement at a cost not to
    exceed $100,000 (ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS) from the GFR 406 Capital Account.

    Passed by a vote of 5 in favor 0 opposed this 15th day of June 2026.



   Nick Crews                                          Margaret Tyler
  GBOS Fire Liaison                                         Attest
